recipes.title: Halal-cart chicken & rice
recipes.subtitle: Garlic-herb white sauce · warm chickpeas & carrots
recipes.description: Golden spiced chicken, fluffy yellow rice and enough garlicky white sauce for every bite. A small fresh garnish, with warm lemony chickpeas and carrots alongside.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
80 ml water (or your rice packet's ratio)

ingredients.group: Garlic & herb white sauce — use all of it
items: 3 g garlic, crushed to a paste
15 ml water, plus a splash only if needed
60 g cooked chickpeas, drained; unsalted or no-added-salt
100 g carrot, peeled and finely diced
20 g iceberg lettuce, finely shredded and shortened
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across chicken, rice, sauce and side (about a scant ¼ tsp fine salt; weigh if possible)

steps: Wash and dry the vegetables. Cut the tomato into thin slices, stack a few, cut into narrow lengths, then cross-cut into small dice as pictured. Roll the lettuce leaves loosely, slice finely, then cut across the shreds so they are short. Use only the weighed lettuce. Mince the garlic; crush the sauce portion into a paste. Peel the carrot, cut lengthways into slim batons, then cross-cut into small cubes. Keep vegetables and raw chicken on separate boards.

Heat the oven to 210°C conventional / 190°C fan. Toss the carrot with its measured olive oil, smoked paprika and part of the reserved salt. Spread on a small lined tray. Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning halfway. Add the cooked, drained chickpeas for the final 5 minutes. Finish with the side's lemon juice and parsley; keep warm.

Rinse and drain the rice. Put it in a small, snug-lidded saucepan with the measured water, turmeric and a little of the reserved salt. Bring to a gentle boil, cover, then cook on the lowest heat for 10–12 minutes. Take off the heat and rest, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork. If your rice packet specifies a different water ratio, follow that ratio.

Stir the Greek yogurt with the sauce's garlic paste, finely chopped parsley, lemon juice and water. Add a little of the reserved salt and optional chilli flakes. Stir until smooth, then refrigerate while the chicken cooks. Add another small splash of water only if it will not pour.

Pat the chicken dry. Cut into bite-sized chunks, then toss with the chicken's olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, oregano, black pepper and remaining reserved salt. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in one uncrowded layer. Leave for 2–3 minutes to colour, then turn and cook for about 5–7 minutes more. Lower the heat if the spices darken quickly. Check several of the thickest pieces with a food thermometer: they must reach 74°C. Rest for 3 minutes.

Taste the rice and carrot for tenderness. Stir the sauce again. If any cooked chicken pieces feel too large for a comfortable spoonful, chop them smaller on a clean board. Keep the lettuce and tomato fresh and cold until serving.

Spoon the cooked rice onto the plate and add the chicken. Add the weighed tomato and small amount of lettuce at the edge. Drizzle about two-fifths of the white sauce over the chicken; serve the rest in a small bowl. Serve the warm chickpea-carrot side in its own bowl. Bring all three dishes to the table together.

tl.description: Golden na manok na may spices, buhaghag na dilaw na kanin at masaganang puting sarsa na may bawang. Kaunting sariwang garnish, at hiwalay na mainit na chickpeas at carrot na may lemon.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
35 g basmati rice, timbang bago lutuin
80 ml tubig (o ayon sa ratio sa pakete)

ingredients.group: Puting sarsa na may bawang at herbs — gamitin lahat
items: 15 ml tubig, dagdagan lang nang kaunti kung kailangan

ingredients.group: Mainit na chickpeas at carrot — hiwalay na ihain
items: 60 g lutong chickpeas, pinatulo, walang dagdag na asin
100 g carrot, binalatan at pinong diced

ingredients.group: Sariwang garnish at asin para sa buong recipe
items: 20 g iceberg lettuce, pinong hiniwa at pinaikli
1 g asin SA BUONG RECIPE, hatiin sa manok, kanin, sarsa at side (halos kulang na ¼ tsp pinong asin; timbangin kung maaari)

steps: Hugasan at patuyuin ang gulay. Hiwain nang manipis ang kamatis, patungin ang ilang hiwa, hiwain nang pahaba at saka pahalang para maging maliliit na dice gaya sa larawan. Irolyo nang maluwag ang letsugas, hiwain nang pino at paikliin ang mga hibla. Gamitin lamang ang tinimbang na letsugas. Tadtarin ang bawang; durugin pa ang para sa sarsa hanggang maging paste. Balatan ang carrot, hiwain nang pahaba at saka gawing maliliit na cube. Ihiwalay ang sangkalan ng gulay sa hilaw na manok.

Painitin ang oven sa 210°C conventional / 190°C fan. Ihalo sa carrot ang nakalaang olive oil, smoked paprika at bahagi ng asin. Ikalat sa maliit na tray na may baking paper. I-roast nang 20–25 minuto at baligtarin sa kalagitnaan. Idagdag ang lutong chickpeas sa huling 5 minuto. Ihalo ang nakalaang lemon juice at parsley at panatilihing mainit.

Banlawan at patuluin ang bigas. Ilagay sa maliit na kaserolang may mahigpit na takip kasama ang nakalaang tubig, turmeric at kaunting asin. Pakuluan nang mahina, takpan, at lutuin sa pinakamahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Alisin sa apoy at hayaang nakatakip nang 10 minuto. Buhaghagin gamit ang tinidor. Kung iba ang water ratio sa pakete ng bigas, iyon ang sundin.

Paghaluin ang Greek yogurt, bawang na paste, pinong parsley, lemon juice at tubig na nakalaan sa sarsa. Dagdagan ng kaunting asin at opsyonal na chilli flakes. Haluin hanggang makinis at ilagay muna sa refrigerator habang niluluto ang manok. Dagdagan lang ng kaunting tubig kung hindi maibuhos.

Patuyuin ang manok. Hiwain sa mga tipak na kasya sa isang subo at ihalo ang nakalaang olive oil, lemon juice, bawang, cumin, coriander, oregano, black pepper at natitirang asin. Painitin ang non-stick na kawali sa medium-high. Ilagay ang manok sa isang layer na hindi siksikan. Huwag galawin nang 2–3 minuto, saka baligtarin at lutuin pa nang mga 5–7 minuto. Hinaan ang apoy kung mabilis umitim ang spices. Sukatin ang ilang pinakamakapal na piraso gamit ang food thermometer: dapat umabot sa 74°C. Ipahinga nang 3 minuto.

Tikman kung malambot na ang kanin at carrot. Haluin muli ang sarsa. Kung may piraso ng lutong manok na masyadong malaki para sa kutsara, paliitin sa malinis na sangkalan. Panatilihing malamig at sariwa ang letsugas at kamatis hanggang ihain.

Ilagay ang kanin sa plato at ipatong ang manok. Ilagay sa gilid ang tinimbang na kamatis at kaunting letsugas. Ibuhos ang mga dalawang-kalima ng sarsa sa manok at ilagay ang natira sa maliit na mangkok. Ihain ang mainit na chickpea-carrot side sa hiwalay na mangkok. Dalhin nang sabay ang tatlong lalagyan sa mesa.

visual.subtitle: Golden chicken. Yellow rice. Plenty of white sauce.

hero.alt: Chicken over yellow rice with white herb sauce, a small lettuce and tomato garnish, and separate carrot-chickpea and sauce bowls.
hero.caption: Plating guide · keep the side and extra sauce separate. Use the measured recipe, not the picture, for portions.

steps.title: Prepare the small cuts
steps.cue: Tomato pieces sit comfortably together on a spoon. Lettuce is a small garnish, not a bed.

photo.alt: Finely diced tomato, short fine lettuce shreds and minced garlic beside a tablespoon.
photo.caption: Cut guide · use the tablespoon for scale. Keep the lettuce shreds short; crush the sauce garlic even finer into a paste.

steps.title: Start the warm side
steps.cue: Carrots should be tender with browned edges; chickpeas warm and soft, not dried hard.

steps.title: Cook the yellow rice
steps.cue: Separate, tender grains. If still firm, add a splash of boiling water and steam a little longer.

steps.title: Make plenty of white sauce
steps.cue: It should fall from a spoon in a thick ribbon, not sit in a stiff mound. All of this sauce belongs to one serving.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.cue: Golden edges and juicy centres. Colour alone cannot establish that chicken is safely cooked.

photo.alt: Bite-sized seasoned chicken pieces with golden brown edges in a skillet.
photo.caption: Browning guide · golden edges, not blackened spices. A thermometer must read 74°C in the thickest pieces.

steps.title: Check the texture
steps.cue: A spoonful can contain chicken, rice and sauce together without a large chunk taking over.

steps.title: Put it on the table
steps.cue: The extra sauce and warm side are part of the dinner, not optional extras in the nutrition total.

photo.alt: Chicken over yellow rice with white herb sauce, a small lettuce and tomato garnish, and separate carrot-chickpea and sauce bowls.
photo.caption: Plating guide · keep the side and extra sauce separate. Use the measured recipe, not the picture, for portions.

components.title: Chicken & yellow rice
components.body: 200 g raw chicken breast and 35 g dry basmati. Cumin, coriander, oregano and garlic; chopped into comfortable bites.

components.title: All the white sauce
components.body: 120 g of 2% Greek yogurt becomes roughly 150 g of garlic-herb sauce. Drizzle generously and serve the rest alongside.

components.title: A little fresh crunch
components.body: 80 g tomato and just 20 g lettuce. Small dice and short, fine shreds, with a cut photo to follow.

components.title: Warm chickpeas & carrots
components.body: A separate lemony, smoky side for fibre. This is the proposed side to try; flag it in Review if it doesn't appeal.

visual.adjustment: The chickpea side supplies much of this meal’s fibre. If the portion feels too much, flag it in Review so we can adjust gradually. Changing the side also changes the nutrition total.
visual.basis: Rounded estimates use generic USDA-style composition, raw chicken and rice weights, cooked chickpea weight and plain 2% Greek yogurt. About 17 g fat per dinner. Brands and cooking yields vary; this is not a lab analysis. Rice and chickpeas both count towards carbohydrate. Contains milk. This dinner has not yet been taste-tested.

nutritionCalculation.units: Generic estimates per 100 g; kcal, protein, carbohydrate, fat, fibre

tl.subtitle: Golden na manok. Dilaw na kanin. Masaganang puting sarsa.

hero.alt: Chicken over yellow rice with white herb sauce, a small lettuce and tomato garnish, and separate carrot-chickpea and sauce bowls.
hero.caption: Gabay sa paghahain · hiwalay ang side dish at dagdag na sarsa. Sundin ang nakasulat na dami, hindi ang larawan.

steps.title: Ihanda ang maliliit na hiwa
steps.cue: Maraming piraso ng kamatis ang kasya sa kutsara. Kaunting letsugas lang bilang garnish.

photo.alt: Finely diced tomato, short fine lettuce shreds and minced garlic beside a tablespoon.
photo.caption: Gabay sa hiwa · kutsara ang batayan sa laki. Paikliin ang letsugas at durugin pa ang bawang para sa sarsa.

steps.title: Simulan ang mainit na side dish
steps.cue: Malambot ang carrot at may browned edges. Mainit at malambot ang chickpeas, hindi tuyot.

steps.title: Lutuin ang dilaw na kanin
steps.cue: Malambot at buhaghag ang kanin. Kung matigas pa, dagdagan ng kaunting kumukulong tubig at pasingawan pa.

steps.title: Gawin ang masaganang puting sarsa
steps.cue: Dumadaloy mula sa kutsara na parang makapal na ribbon, hindi namumuo. Lahat ng sarsang ito ay para sa isang serving.

steps.title: I-brown ang manok
steps.cue: Golden ang gilid at makatas ang loob. Hindi sapat ang kulay para masabing ligtas nang kainin.

photo.alt: Bite-sized seasoned chicken pieces with golden brown edges in a skillet.
photo.caption: Gabay sa browning · golden, hindi sunog. Dapat umabot sa 74°C ang pinakamakapal na piraso.

steps.title: Tingnan ang texture
steps.cue: Kasya sa isang kutsara ang manok, kanin at sarsa nang walang sobrang laking tipak.

steps.title: Ihain sa mesa
steps.cue: Kasama ang dagdag na sarsa at side dish sa nutrisyon ng buong hapunan.

photo.alt: Chicken over yellow rice with white herb sauce, a small lettuce and tomato garnish, and separate carrot-chickpea and sauce bowls.
photo.caption: Gabay sa paghahain · hiwalay ang side at dagdag na sarsa. Sundin ang timbang sa recipe.

components.title: Manok at dilaw na kanin
components.body: 200 g hilaw na chicken breast at 35 g tuyong basmati. May cumin, coriander, oregano at bawang; maliliit na tipak.

components.title: Lahat ng puting sarsa
components.body: Ang 120 g na 2% Greek yogurt ay nagiging mga 150 g na garlic-herb sauce. Ibuhos ang bahagi at ihain ang natira sa tabi.

components.title: Kaunting sariwang gulay
components.body: 80 g kamatis at 20 g letsugas lamang. Maliit na dice at maiikling pinong hibla; sundin ang larawan.

components.title: Mainit na chickpeas at carrot
components.body: Hiwalay na side dish na may lemon at smoky na lasa para sa fibre. Panukalang side ito; sabihin sa Review kung gusto mong palitan.

tl.adjustment: Malaking bahagi ng fibre ay mula sa chickpeas. Kung sobra para sa tiyan mo, sabihin para unti-unting ma-adjust; huwag basta alisin at gamitin pa rin ang parehong nutrition total.
tl.basis: Tantiyang nutrisyon batay sa generic USDA-style data, hilaw na timbang ng manok at bigas, lutong chickpeas at plain 2% Greek yogurt. Mga 17 g fat bawat hapunan. Nag-iiba ayon sa brand at pagluluto. Kasama sa carbohydrate ang bigas at chickpeas. May gatas. Hindi pa nasubukang lutuin at tikman.
